title: PCB routing diagnostic: continuous-plane lossless 40 mm microstrip approximation
source: Hammerstad and Jensen, IEEE MTT-S 1980 pp.407–409; Pozar Microwave Engineering 4th ed. §4.4. Reference values evaluated independently from the formulas by crates/theory/examples/pcb_line_reference.rs (`cargo run -p emcraft-theory --example pcb_line_reference -- 0.3 0.18 4.2 40 50 1`), which calls none of EMCraft's PCB code. W=0.3 mm, h=0.18 mm, er=4.2; 50-ohm terminations, 1 GHz.

quantities.reason: Independent evaluation (pcb_line_reference) of the published HJ fit and uniform lossless TEM line; this validates the approximation implementation, not a full-wave PCB.
